package com.x;
public class BRoomPanel extends BWebServlet {
  void route(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) { asset(resp, req.getParameter("v") != null);
    tagged(resp, "a", req.getParameter("ver") != null); constantToo(resp, req.getParameter("v") != null); }
  void other(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) { constantToo(resp, true); open(resp, req.getParameter("v") != null); }
  void direct(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", req.getParameter("v") != null ? "public, max-age=3600" : "no-cache");
  }
  private void asset(HttpServletResponse resp, boolean fingerprinted) {
    if (fingerprinted) resp.setContentType("text/css");
    // a request without ?v= is never cached
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", fingerprinted ? "public, max-age=3600" : "no-cache");
    resp.setHeader("X-Frame-Options", "SAMEORIGIN");
  }
  private void tagged(HttpServletResponse resp, String path,
      boolean versioned) {
    resp.setContentType(path);
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", versioned ? "max-age=600" : "no-cache");
  }
  void always(HttpServletResponse resp) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=3600");
  }
  void inverted(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", req.getParameter("v") != null ? "no-cache" : "max-age=60");
  }
  void named(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", req.getParameter("debug") != null ? "max-age=60" : "no-cache");
  }
  void open(HttpServletResponse resp, boolean fingerprinted) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", fingerprinted ? "max-age=60" : "no-cache");
  }
  private void constantToo(HttpServletResponse resp, boolean fingerprinted) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", fingerprinted ? "max-age=60" : "no-cache");
  }
  private void uncalled(HttpServletResponse resp, boolean fingerprinted) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", fingerprinted ? "max-age=60" : "no-cache");
  }
  void absent(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", req.getParameter("v") == null ? "max-age=60" : "no-cache");
  }
  void either(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp, boolean debug) { mixed(resp, debug ? true : req.getParameter("v") != null);
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", req.getParameter("v") != null || debug ? "max-age=60" : "no-cache");
  }
  private void mixed(HttpServletResponse resp, boolean fingerprinted) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", fingerprinted ? "max-age=60" : "no-cache");
  }
  void notTernary(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) {
    resp.setHeader("Cache-Control", choose(req.getParameter("v") != null, "max-age=60"));
  }
}
